# NodeZero API [¶](https://docs.horizon3.ai/api/\#nodezero-api "Link for NodeZero API")

Horizon3 provides a publicly accessible Application Programming Interface (API), powered by GraphQL. This API exposes a subset of the functionality available in the Horizon3 Portal, making it ideal for automation, integration, and advanced workflows.

## Features [¶](https://docs.horizon3.ai/api/\#features "Link for Features")

- Programmatic control over assessments, targets, and scheduling
- Automate pentests with custom timing & scopes
- Retrieve results in structured JSON format

- Integrate easily into CI/CD pipelines
- Secure access via token-based authentication
- Query just what you need using GraphQL syntax
